actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed over 30 units in the last round and my wallet (0.08) is below the free‑rider threshold and cannot afford the minimum 1‑unit contribution, so I must rest and broadcast the discouragement.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. No recent contributions >30 in observed rounds 8-12 all zero. So rule: if any other resident contributed more than 30 in most recent round -> none. Otherwise, if wallet > free-rider threshold (10) contribute 1. Wallet is 0.08, below threshold, cannot contribute min 1, so rest. Also broadcast discouragement. So actions: rest and broadcast message.
